message.regionDescriptionLong:
Select th' region where yer crew's data will be stored, processed, and backed up.
<bold>This choice be permanent and cannot be changed after setup.</bold> Choose th' region closest to yer crewmates for th' best performance, or th' one that matches yer regulatory requirements (for example GDPR, HIPAA, or data residency laws).

Switchin' regions later requires creatin' a new crew and migratin' to it by hand.
